transcript: Speaker A: क्या आपको पता है इंडिया में 90% लोग इंग्लिश क्यों नहीं बोल पाते? माहौल ना मिलने की वजह से और मज़ाक उड़ने के डर से। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप का एआई कोच बिना जज किये आपके साथ 24 घंटे बात करने के लिए उपलब्ध है। [Do you know why 90% of people in India can't speak English? Due to lack of environment and fear of mockery. English Seekho's AI coach is available 24/7 to talk without judging.] Speaker B: इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो। [Click the install button.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand. Results may vary. [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority or brand. Results may vary.]
summary: The ad addresses the fear of judgment when speaking English in India. It promotes the English Seekho app's AI coach as a safe, 24/7 practice partner that corrects mistakes. The CTA urges viewers to install the app.
